hyps.why: Replacing a removed edge 3 with a 3x3 conv restores the direct input-output path and gave +3.8/+6.5/+17.5, versus much smaller gains when replacing skip, avg_pool or 1x1.
Adding skip to an empty edge 3 gave +2.9/+6.5/+13.8, versus +1.9/+2.8/+5.0 when replacing 1x1 and negative effects when replacing 3x3.
Removing a 3x3 conv on edge 3 cost -3.8/-6.5/-17.5, more than removing a 1x1 conv (-1.0/-3.7/-8.8).
Upgrading an avg_pool edge 0 to 3x3 conv gave only +2.3/+3.6/+3.7, less than from none, skip or 1x1 (about +3 to +4 on C10, +8.5 to +10 on IN16).
With edge 3 already a 3x3 conv, adding another 3x3 on edge 5 gave +0.3/+1.5/+0.5, versus about +2.4 to +2.9 on C10 and +6.8 to +8.8 on IN16 otherwise.
Replacing a 3x3 conv on edge 5 with avg_pool hurt on all datasets, whereas replacing a 1x1 conv gave +1.7/+0.7/+5.1.
Swapping a 3x3 conv on edge 4 for avg_pool lost -2.0/-3.6/-6.3, while from none, skip or 1x1 it was neutral to positive.
Replacing a 3x3 conv on edge 0 with skip lost -3.4/-5.0/-8.5, versus about zero when replacing a 1x1 conv.
Edge 1 to 3x3 gave smaller gains from avg_pool (+1.5/+3.0/+3.5) than from none, skip or 1x1 (about +2.3 to +3.5 on C10, +7.9 to +9.5 on IN16).
Downgrading a 3x3 conv on edge 2 to 1x1 cost -2.8/-3.3/-10.6, whereas replacing none or skip was about neutral.
